title: Armor: Waist
description: Replicate the waist armor piece from Blender-Procedural-Human in Ixdar DSL. Source: procedural_human/geo_node_groups/armor/waist.py. Key techniques: bi_rail_loft, pipes, gem_in_holder, gold_on_band, bezier segments, flip-faces, mesh-to-curve. Similar structure to chest but less complex.
definition-of-done: 1. waist.dsl compiles without errors. 2. Mesh comparison gate passes. 3. Visual comparison shows recognizable silhouette match.
testing-plan: 1. Export Blender reference OBJ. 2. Run validate-dsl to export generated OBJ. 3. Run mesh_distance() comparison. 4. Visual inspection.
